body: We are thrilled to showcase our latest camper van conversion, a stunning Mercedes Sprinter 144" AWD that combines luxury, functionality, and off-grid capability. Designed with football tailgates in mind, this van is perfect for our adventurous customer who loves to blend their passion for travel with their love for the game.

At the heart of this conversion is a spacious and cozy queen-sized memory foam bed, ensuring restful nights after days of exploration and lively tailgates. The interior is beautifully finished with painted shiplap siding and a wood-stained ceiling, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The acacia butcher block countertop adds a touch of elegance, complemented by a stainless steel undermount sink with hot and cold faucet, making meal preparation a breeze.

For those who love cooking, especially during game day, the van is equipped with a portable single burner induction cooktop, an Isotherm Cruise 85 refrigerator with freezer, and a 22” Blackstone Electric Griddle, perfect for grilling burgers and hotdogs at the tailgate. The Maxxair Deluxe ceiling vent fan with remote, along with the recessed, dimmable LED ceiling lights, ensure excellent ventilation and lighting, enhancing the overall living experience.

This van is ready for off-grid adventures with its robust power system, including a 300W solar system, 800Ah Lithium Iron Battery, and a 3000W pure sine wave inverter/charger. Additionally, the 30A shore power electrical plugin and multiple 110v outlets with USB/A&C ports ensure all devices and appliances stay powered. The Espar diesel-powered cabin heater and 12v roof-mounted Dometic A/C unit with remote provide year-round comfort, no matter the weather.

Outdoor enthusiasts and football fans alike will appreciate the practical features such as the roof rack and ladder, electric awning, and rear door outdoor shower, making this van perfect for both rugged terrains and stadium parking lots. With thoughtful additions like the Laveo Dry Flush Toilet, Lagun swivel/adjustable table, and premium insulation package, this camper van offers a seamless blend of luxury and practicality, ready to support the ultimate vanlife experience and the best football tailgates.
